_comment: Example configuration for a CDK-based application
_templatePathComment: For CDK applications, specify the path to the synthesized CloudFormation template. The path should be relative to the build output root and typically follows the pattern 'cdk.out/<StackName>.template.json'. For SAM applications, omit this field to use the default 'template.yaml'.
_deploymentTargetsComment: List of environment names to deploy to. These must match environment names defined in cdk.json or config/environments/. The pipeline will automatically resolve account, region, and other environment-specific settings from the environment configuration.
